Refinancing rate left unchanged at 6.75 % Back

​Press Release
March 18, 2025
Refinancing rate left unchanged at 6.75 %

At its March 18 meeting, the Board of the Central Bank of Armenia decided to:
  • Leave the Refinancing Rate unchanged at 6.75%.
  • Set the Lombard Repo Facility Rate at 8.25%.
  • Set the Deposit Facility Rate at 5.25%.
The Press Conference, led by CBA Governor Martin Galstyan, will take place today at 14:00, and will be streamed live on the CBA’s YouTube channel and Facebook page.

The CBA Transparency Report will be published today at 18:00 օn the CBA website.
